title: Enzymatic Activity of Electron Transport System Complexes I
author: Wen Aw
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rq5d5y6

steps.title: Dilute mitochondria stock
steps.instruction: Dilute the mitochondrial preparation with distilled water to a concentration of 0.4 µg/µL.

steps.title: Add diluted mitochondria to water
steps.instruction: Pipette 5 µL of the diluted mitochondria into 73 µL of distilled water and incubate for 1 minute.

steps.title: Prepare buffer mix
steps.instruction: Combine the following in a tube: 100 µL potassium phosphate buffer (0.5 M, pH 7.5), 60 µL fatty‑acid‑free BSA (50 mg/mL), 30 µL KCN (10 mM), and 10 µL NADH (10 mM).

steps.title: Add buffer mix to assay
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL of the prepared buffer mix to the reaction mixture (mitochondria in water).

steps.title: Prepare parallel rotenone control well
steps.instruction: Set up a second well containing the same volumes of diluted mitochondria, water, and buffer mix as the assay well, then add 10 µL of 1 mM rotenone.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 µL diluted mitochondria to 73 µL distilled water, incubate 1 min.
Add 20 µL of the same buffer mix prepared above.

steps.title: Initiate reaction with ubiquinone
steps.instruction: Start the enzymatic reaction by adding 1 µL of 10 mM ubiquinone to each well (assay and control).

steps.title: Record absorbance for 3 minutes
steps.instruction: Measure the reaction reading (e.g., absorbance or fluorescence) continuously for 3 minutes.
